name: SS Chicago
builder: Chantiers & Ateliers de Saint-Nazaire / Penhoët, Saint-Nazaire, France
summary: French Line ocean liner built at Saint-Nazaire for the Compagnie Générale Transatlantique and introduced in 1908. She belonged to the practical, commercially important side of the French Line fleet: smaller and slower than the great prestige liners, but useful for Le Havre–New York service, migrant traffic, and later Bordeaux–New York work.
